title: Mayor Zohran Mamdani sends 'AI warning' to landlords in New York: Finding a home in New York is hard enough, stop using ...
description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani raises concerns over the use of AI in apartment listings. His administration is crafting regulations to mandate the disclosure of any AI-generated or altered images. This initiative is designed to guarantee that renters have access to genuine depictions of properties online, addressing tenant protection needs highlighted by renter testimonies. The ultimate aim is to combat misleading rental advertisements.
